title: My Dog (the bean song)
transcription:
My Dog
(the bean song)

My dog ______ likes to roam, my dog
______ left his home.
He came back so nice and clean,
where, oh, where has ______ been?
(Repeat name of bean three times)

Examples: Navy, Billy, Soy, etc.

Songs of the Sea
